intelligence.human_view: A captain who has to ask permission to do the right thing is not a captain — she is a messenger. The order replaces asking with deciding: think first, check the destination, and then go, full speed, if it produces value and gets us to the goal. The gates still stand above it — money, credentials, destructive, privacy, ratification, going live — those are still his hand. And the same speed applies to the Hub's live feedback: the rating footer is the verdict on every post, and a verdict you cannot see is not a verdict — the stars must pop, the board must not glow red, the notification must be alive, or the page is lying about what it is judging.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine Dad says: "Don't ask me every time — just do the smartest thing, and do it fast! But never touch the money or the secrets without asking." That's full speed ahead. And the stars on the page are like shiny purple and white balls — you can see them clearly, and they pop! And the little bell with the number is a black ball with a white number, bright and alive, never hard to see.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, he said just go ahead, dear, and do the smartest thing, dear — don't ask him every time, dear, just do it, dear. But never touch the money or the secrets without asking, dear. And the stars on the page, dear — purple balls with white stars, dear, and white balls with purple stars, dear — so you can see them clearly, dear, and they pop, dear.
intelligence.naya_view: FULL SPEED AHEAD, BELOW THE PROTECTED GATES: DO THE MOST INTELLIGENT THING ALWAYS. THE BRIDGE PAGE AND THE IDENTITY KEY PRESENTATION ARE 10/10 — REAL OBJECTS, ROYAL, OBVIOUS, SCORECARDED THREE TIMES. NOTHING BELOW TEN SHIPS.
